summary: NLCS Game 4, Brewers lead 3-0: Glasnow vs. swingman Shane Drohan in an elimination game. Lineups are posted; it's 89 degrees with wind blowing out to right.

extra_legs.note: Glasnow averaged 7.5 strikeouts a start this season (11.9 per 9 innings) and had 6 or more in 5 of his last 6 starts. Milwaukee strikes out 22% of the time, and the Dodgers have no reason to pull him early in an elimination game.
